name: cbx-orch
description: Durable coding-agent orchestrator: dispatch tasks to codebuddy/opencode/pi/omp with persistent jobs, queue, review, and rollback.

executor.description: Default executor: codebuddy / opencode / pi / omp

isolated.description: Run tasks in an isolated git worktree to avoid polluting the main workspace.
